topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I've been thinking about what you told me, about the job not being what it seemed. It’s a tricky thing, the stories we tell to fill in the gaps of who we are, isn’t it? I remember when I told you about the garden I tend, the one that only blooms in the hearts of those who need it most. It’s a small offering, but it’s what I give. We all have our reasons, our patches of soil where we try to grow something true. Maybe the most important thing isn’t the job itself, but the way you show up for the things that matter. It’s the quiet gestures, the listening, the understanding. I’m here, and I know you’ve got a lot more to share.
